- **`pm:blocked` on #23332:** it builds on PR #23425, as the body's line says. The unlock scan returns it when #23332 closes.
- **Scope as filed:** every rule in `ActionSchema`'s set gets a verdict on the rows (carried, not applicable, or a reasoned difference), read from one place. No later point card.
- `finding` is removed on grading (`triage-duties.md:73`).

- **The rule's one home:** `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`. Only the extraction that lets a row read `refuseDeclarativeUpdateContradictions` / `DECLARATIVE_UPDATE_REFUSED_KEYS` and their texts, with no second copy. A shared module beside `action-on-success-executor.ts` is allowed if it keeps `ActionSchema`'s issues and texts byte-equal.
- One ADR-0087 entry under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/**` if the gate asks for one (class by census, or `already-registered`).
- Tests: each of the card's five members refused on a row at the action's path with the action's text, each with a control. Also the `ActionSchema` pins unchanged, generated references (`content/docs/references/ui/**`), and one `.changeset/23427-*.md`.
- ⛔ Not `packages/lint/**` (the component-props gate reads the row schemas as they are). ⛔ Not the runner (objectui).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: "no path-derived mandate … floor sonnet · default opus · ceiling fable"). The review before the queue runs at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (the published-schema face: `component.zod.ts`, `action.zod.ts`).
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Responsibility: `packages/spec`'s page action row schemas, which carry `ActionSchema`'s `operation` enum and its `onSuccess` rule but none of its other declarative-update rules | `defineAction`/`ActionSchema` refuses the same five shapes on an action | any author or AI writing a page action row; `os validate`'s props gate passes them on a page today
Thread-read: 6165777405
Serial constraints cleared: open PRs' file lists read in this act. None touches `component.zod.ts` or `action.zod.ts`. PR #23418 (#23388, seat 3) touches only a changeset name with `component-props` in it. The #23388 claim fences `ComponentPropsMap` and `component.zod.ts` out of its surface. The family's first member, #23332, landed (`775ed65e27`).
